title: Wind Along the Ridges
caption: Original instrumental 3/4 game cue, A major, 126 BPM. Preserve this independently scored 24-bar melody and exact scene-specific rhythm. Lead flute, support harp, independently voiced bass. Scalar melody with consonant thinned accompaniment; no reharmonization, dissonant added notes, vocals or fade.
form_description: 6小節ずつのA–B–A–C。三拍子の風の踊り。
composition_notes: Individually authored literal note-level melody and rhythm. Scalar passing notes receive thinned consonant support rather than a sustained conflicting triad. Explicit scene-specific accompaniment and percussion replace shared automatic figures. This cue has its own melody and phrase form; basic tonal voice-leading review is finite and does not claim all species-counterpoint rules.

harmonic_policy.scalar_melody_policy: Thinned support at nonchord melodic notes; independently scored bass, no fixed-root pedal that clashes with passing tones
harmonic_policy.bass_voice: Independent movement with exposed parallel fifth/octave avoidance
harmonic_policy.release_policy: Per-part release gates before unsafe pitch/harmony transitions; no old support tail may create an unintended clash

identity_description_ja: 広い跳躍と上昇する音階、三拍子、ハープの斜めに流れる和音。
